brief:
An Israeli documentary examining Israeli conduct in Gaza will be made available for free streaming in November following its theatrical release, co-director Yuval Abraham announced, according to Al Jazeera English. The film, titled NAZA, is expected to expose documented abuses during operations in the territory.

Abraham did not specify the exact streaming date or platform. The decision to release the film online at no cost aims to broaden its reach beyond cinema audiences.
dek: Co-director Yuval Abraham says documentary exposing Israeli abuses will be available online in November.
title: Israeli documentary on Gaza abuses to stream free after theaters
